snippet.title: Tunnel 3D ZX Spectrum Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Bats and spiders and tube trains, oh my! I'm probably the only person in the world who remembers this game but here is a walkthrough for it anyway. There is no plot - you just have to avoid crashing into the critters or the walls and make it to the end of the tunnel. You can shoot things for points on the way but its entirely optional.

This is what passed for 3D graphics in 1983 - a load of coloured rectangles. The tube trains looked pretty good once you got that far which was probably the main reason for playing this game. Really tedious gameplay though and not a game I'll ever be playing again. 

There is no way this game warranted more than one video on youtube and it took 30 minutes to finish so I've skipped large sections to get it down to 10 minutes.
